verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a fair question for a hosted AI app-building platform, but the evidence documents no Figma Make API tokens, scopes, or least-privilege agent credentials. The only related item covers Figma securely storing a third-party key for a published app, which is a different feature. A community report also says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, so there is no evidence of programmatic access to scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
